meat-board.name: BÜRNT meat board
meat-board.traits: a pale wood board with visible grain and rounded corners, the dark burned BÜRNT flame mark at its lower left; the smoked bone-in rib eye with its long bone across the middle, fans of pink slices with a dark crust, dark jerky, salami rounds. The meat is never changed: Tzvi allowed generated meat on the film's board only.
meat-board.source: his own photo (scrollcraft/builds/burnt-meatboards/gen/fire-film-brief.md:67,141-143; film-brief.md:6,16). Exact placement (the iron, the mark) is done in code: clip B put the mark in the wrong place twice (fire-film-brief.md:335-337).
